title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v100
author: Anika Shah
description: This PR adds the v100 profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and an updated reporting pipeline integration for the benchmark-lab. Motivation: baseline profiles were stale and did not represent adaptive-batching and multi-variant workloads introduced in recent runtime changes. This PR: 1) Adds canonical profiling baselines for v100 GPU families (latency/throughput/p95/p99 traces), 2) Introduces representative workload runners that exercise mixed latency and throughput modes (chat, instruct, embedding, streaming), 3) Extends the reporting pipeline to ingest per-run metadata, model variant tags, quantization profile IDs, and KV cache warmup traces, 4) Adds CI smoke tests for benchmark-lab runners and a nightly profiling job that publishes baselines to the metrics bucket. Implementation notes: baseline data uses the new compact protobuf format; reporting pipeline uses a small adapter that normalizes legacy CSV exports. The description includes checklist: - [x] Add baselines and runner harness - [x] Wire reporting adapter and pipeline DAG - [x] Add CI unit + integration smoke tests - [x] Docs updated with sample commands and runbook - [x] Load-tested on staging with 1000-run mix. See linked Linear tasks for rollout and follow-ups.
